args.task: find log lines that show a real failure an on-call engineer must act on.

items.text: 10:00:03 WARN  cache miss for key user:4411, refilled from DB
10:00:04 ERROR payment provider declined card (card_declined) for order 9912
10:00:05 ERROR nightly-export job aborted: disk full on /var/data (0 bytes free)
10:00:07 INFO  retry 1/3 succeeded for webhook delivery wh_77

args.criterion: Is log line {id} a real failure an on-call engineer must act on (a crash, data loss or a stuck job), as opposed to routine, benign or expected output?
args.true_means: a real failure that needs action
args.false_means: routine, informational, retried successfully, or an expected business outcome such as a declined card
